thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: Zenith Labs (enterprise VPC, tenant=zenith-prod). Observability gap detected — traces and logs for tenant not arriving since 03:12 UTC. p95 latency ×3 for their requests. Runbook: per-tenant-obsv-gap. Please ack and follow playbook.

ashley_oncall: acked. I'm on call. I see repeated 403s in the forwarder logs: 
```
forwarder: request to obs-collector failed: 403 Forbidden - tenant z-1234: missing access
```
Looks like the tenant forwarder role lost permission during a deployment window.

samir_sre: FYI I'm coming in. Can you paste the last successful span id and a sample request id? need to confirm whether traces are dropped or just not indexed.

ashley_oncall: sample request id: req-0a7f2b. Last span we have in the interceptor was span: none for that id (empty). Logs show batching flush at 03:11 then nothing.

leo_support: I already opened a CS ticket with Zenith; they report dashboard empty, can't correlate user requests with traces. They asked for ETA.

ashley_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) grant temporary forwarding token scoped to obs-forwarder for tenant zenith-prod for 1h; 2) route their forwarder through infra-forwarder proxy with wider perms; 3) request operator to re-run forwarder pod with restored service-account. Which is safest?

samir_sre: safest = scoped ephemeral token while we confirm root cause. I'll try the token flow first. Creating ephemeral token now.

eng_runtime_bot: creating ephemeral token: `rdwctl obs token create --tenant zenith-prod --role forwarder-read --ttl 3600`

samir_sre: token created: tok_eyJz... (rotated via vault). Pushing to forwarder via secure channel to Zenith ops.

ashley_oncall: applied token to their forwarder at 03:25 UTC, forwarding restarted. Early checks: logs show successful 200 responses from collector now.

eng_runtime_bot: collector ingestion metrics for tenant zenith-prod: spans ingested = 0 @03:12 -> 120 @03:27. Metric backlog drained.

leo_support: passing initial update to customer: "We've applied a temporary token and are ingesting traces. We'll follow up with root-cause and a mitigation plan." Customer answered :thumbsup:.

tara_re: filing post-incident: can we confirm whether this was a permissions regression from a recent ACL PR? I saw a change to tenant role propagation on 03:10 in CI.

samir_sre: looking at deploys: infra/acl-service had a canary at 03:08, merged change afaik. Preliminary: the service applied a stricter default role when tenant metadata was missing — that could explain the 403.

ashley_oncall: mitigation timeline for PSR: 03:12 gap begins, 03:25 ephemeral token applied, 03:27 ingestion resumed, 03:40 verified end-to-end traces visible in customer dashboard.

ps-eng: I'll coordinate the customer comms and draft a short RCA and workaround. Requesting eng-runtime to prepare a permanent fix: ensure role propagation is not dropped during canary and add a safety check in the ACL service.

samir_sre: creating incident ticket INC-2026-482 with notes and assigning to eng-runtime. Actions: revert or patch ACL change, add e2e test for tenant metadata propagation, add monitoring alert for forwarder 403 spike.

eng_runtime_bot: ticket INC-2026-482 created. Patch branch: hotfix/acl-propagation-zenith.

ashley_oncall: handing off to samir (sre) and eng-runtime for remediation. I'll keep the thread open for final sign-off.

samir_sre: working with @eng_runtime on the patch. Quick test in staging shows metadata present after patch. Will promote to canary and watch 15m.

eng_runtime_bot: canary promoted at 04:58 UTC. No 403 spikes observed in 30m window.

leo_support: customer notified of permanent fix and timeline. They asked for a postmortem and whether additional SLAs apply — PS will handle.

tara_re: reminder: add to runbook that ephemeral token flow is our documented fallback and include `rdwctl obs token create` example.

ashley_oncall: closing loop: mitigation complete, customer impact limited to ~13 minutes of missing observability. Root cause: regression in ACL propagation during an ACL service canary. Next steps assigned in INC-2026-482. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident thread closed by ashley_oncall at 05:15 UTC.
